title: GPT-6 Astra  is HERE! Your Imagination is the Limit -  OpenAI is BACK!
description:
GPT-6 Astra is here, and the pitch is one line: anything you can do on a computer, Astra can do for you, fast.
It drives Blender, Unity, Final Cut and the browser itself, and it runs for days without you.
But it costs $10 in and $50 out per million tokens, 2.5x GPT-5.6 Sol, and on the independent Intelligence Index it scores 61, level with the model it replaces and five points behind Claude Fable 5.1.
This is the full picture: what it does, who gets it, what it really costs, every major day-one demo, and the benchmark numbers that fall apart the moment you ask which harness produced them.
Watch the bill before you switch.
